newsitem.title: USA: Stimsonite sees year net at/below $0.50-0.73 range.
newsitem.headline: Stimsonite sees year net at/below $0.50-0.73 range.

text.p: Stimsonite Corp Chief Financial Officer Thomas Ratchford said Thursday the company expects 1996 year end per share earnings to be at or below the low end of a range of analysts' estimates of $0.50 to $0.73.
Stimsonite, which makes and markets highway safety products, reported 1995 year end earnings of $0.29 a share.

Wednesday, the company had projected 1996 earnings would be at or below the low end of estimates but did not identify those estimates. According to First Call, analysts estimate Stimsonite 1996 earnings in a range of $0.70 to $0.73.
Stimsonite repeated that both its optical film and international business units have not achieved their expected 1996 sales growth.

During the 1996 first half, sales and earnings benefited from strong growth in the company's domestic highway delineation product lines. This part of the domestic business is expected to continue to show growth in the second half, but it will be at a lower rate than during the first half of the year, the company had said in a statement.
